lines.zh: 我直直地立着挪过来，膝盖不弯。
lines.en: I approach upright, knees unbent.
My steps swing like a pendulum.
My hat does not move as I walk.
I come around from behind the shelves.

lines.zh: 我的影子拖得比身体长。
lines.en: My shadow trails longer than my body.

lines.zh: 脚底蹭过瓷砖，发出细响。
lines.en: My feet rasp on the tiles.
I walk toward where you stand.
Every third step, I pause.

lines.zh: 身体僵得很，像被摆过姿势。
lines.en: My body is stiff, as if posed.

lines.zh: 我不是走，我是被推着走。
lines.en: I am not walking. I am being pushed.
My violet arms hang low.
The hall lamps flicker with me.
Standing like a display piece.
I have held this pose a long time.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，眼里没有光。
lines.en: Perfectly still, no light in my eyes.
My fingers are slightly apart.
I wait for someone to walk by.
My hat is crooked. I cannot fix it.
One foot forward, one back.
The plastic smell fills this room.
A loose thread hangs to the floor.
I tilt my head a little.
You are standing in the wrong place.
I have been in this corner a long while.
You have passed me twice.

lines.zh: 我看着你，却没有转眼睛。
lines.en: I watch you without turning my eyes.

lines.zh: 这一身紫黑，和墙一个色。
lines.en: This violet black matches the wall.

lines.zh: 你的影子贴到我的脚上。
lines.en: Your shadow touches my feet.
This time I am standing.
Which floor are you going to?
Do not speak so fast.
I tilt, then straighten.
My pose is broken.
The violet cloth splits.
The plastic rings under the blow.
That genuinely hurt.
I put out a hand to the wall.
My hat fell. I ignore it.
I can still hold my shape.
I have raised my head.
What you hold is shining.
Leave it on the shelf.
Who is that prepared for?
I smell sugar.
Closer. I cannot see well.
What are you trading that for?
I am in no hurry. But I want it.
Do not take it. I am still looking.
One step away, set it down.
You brushed my arm.
I held this pose unchanged.
Step back. I balance poorly.
My feet cannot turn easily.
You hit hard plastic.
Let us simply pass by.
My knees do not bend.
Steady. I must keep my pose.
Do not squeeze in from behind.
I cannot give much room.
I can barely turn.
This body has been posed.
Do not stand in front of me.
This pose cannot be changed.
I have no such intention.
The night staff never ask that.
Look for someone else.
Too close. Back away.
First I must bend my knees.
This pose will not let me bend.
I nudge it over with my foot.
Something dropped on the tiles.
I kick it against the wall.
I keep this one.
Cannot see. Too dark.
Do not step on what is on the floor.
I can just barely reach.
Leave it. I will get it later.
This pose is about to change.
You are in my line of sight.
There is no second exit.
I move my feet first.

lines.zh: 你的名字写在登记册上。
lines.en: Your name is in the register.
The lamps begin to flicker.
I remember your face.
The one standing there is you.
No running. Just this.
I lower my hat.
This floor is mine.

lines.zh: 我保持这个姿势看着你。
lines.en: I watch you in this pose.
My head stays; my eyes move.

lines.zh: 你再往前，就到我面前了。
lines.en: Any closer and you are before me.

lines.zh: 瓷砖上的声音，只有你的。
lines.en: Only your steps sound on the tiles.

lines.zh: 暗影残骸挂在我身上，走一路掉一路。
lines.en: Shadow scrap hangs off me, dropping as I walk.
My fingers open a little.
Half the lamps are out.
Both ends of this hall are blocked.
You looked back just now.
I need no speed. I can stand.
The handle is in your hand.
It will not turn at all.
Wait a little longer.
I shift my weight to the front foot.
Your shadow is pinned to the floor.
Every lamp is out.
This one, right before me.
I am no longer an exhibit.
My joints are turning.
It is time to strike.
A straight punch from above.
My feet finally move.
I ram forward. Hard.
My palm presses your shoulder.
You knocked my hat off.
That one made my joints shriek.
I push you to the wall.
An elbow lands on your back.
You retreat. I still stand.
That one was heavy enough.
You grab my hand. It does not hold.
I leave you sitting on the floor.
My hand never came down.
We change places.
Do you hear the plastic creak?
That will be the end.
I have been standing here all along.
The light came on, and you saw me.
This corner was always mine.
I kept this pose, waiting.
My top hat is a little crooked.
I did not move, yet I am here.
A violet stain on the tiles.

lines.zh: 你走进来的时候，我就在。
lines.en: I was here when you walked in.
I raise my head higher.
This is not my first time standing.
My body has been set upright.
Look at this face of mine.
Fire spreads from one spot on the cloth.

lines.zh: 我整个倒下，姿势全乱了。
lines.en: I fall entirely, pose destroyed.
Water seeps into the plastic seams.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我推得撞在货架上。
lines.en: The blast throws me into the shelves.
This light thins the violet black.
I do not eat, but I cannot hold.

lines.zh: 电让我僵直的关节跳了一下。
lines.en: Current makes my stiff joints jump.
No wall to brace against below.
